sectionSubtitle: Things we've noticed about how you like to travel. You're always in control — confirm what's right, dismiss what isn't.
noMemoryYet: We haven't noticed any travel preferences yet. As you use the planner, we'll start to learn what you enjoy.
noticedHint: Based on how you've used the planner. Confirm the ones that feel right.
resetDescription: This will remove all preferences we've learned from your behaviour. Your confirmed preferences and account settings will not be affected.
resetConfirm: Are you sure? This cannot be undone.
privacyNote: Your travel memory is private — it's only ever used to personalise your own itineraries. We never share it, never use it for advertising, and never infer sensitive personal attributes from where you travel.
